title: Looking for traders for a two-week AI Trading Challenge ($2,500 prize)
author: Fynca
selftext:
The first challenge was much better than we expected; 2 Reddit users won, so we opened another one for next week.

After speaking with more than 50 analysts worldwide, we built Fynca, an AI-powered visual workspace for capital markets research and market ideas.  
Now we're looking for traders to test it in a simulated trading challenge. Each trader gets demo capital. After 11 days, the traders with the highest returns $2,500 cash prize pool.  
No real money is traded, just your research, strategy, and execution. I'm also doing 1-on-1 demo meetings to explain the system or discuss any considerations.

comments.author: IshigamiSenku04
comments.body: HOW much 1st position will get from 2500$ price pool?

comments.author: web3_news
comments.body: Risk-adjusted scoring, or a max drawdown cap, would give you far more useful signal from the same participants.👍

replies.author: Fynca
replies.body: That’s exactly the direction we’re planning for future tournaments, including risk-adjusted scoring and drawdown rules. Really appreciate the suggestion. We’d love to have you join the community and help us improve each season with more feedback like this.
